text:
Maya: Starting scheduled change-window for r2030 (roll id: roll-2030-11). Preflight checks running now. Planned ramp: 2% -> 20% over 8m. If SLOs degrade, we abort.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: routing, config, quota, slo-probe — in progress

Nikhil: Pulling up SLO dashboard for embed-service and gen-service. Link: https://console/redwood/d/abc/slo-overview

Priya: Seeing a maintenance job scheduled on gpu-pool-9 at 10:07 UTC (KV-cache GC). That's within the ramp window.

Maya: Oh, GC overlaps the first 10m. That's bad for cold-cache canaries. Abort if scheduled GC can't be moved.

Nikhil: Confirming: infra-scheduler shows gc.schedule="2026-11-07T10:07:00Z" on nodes in eu-central.

Priya: Posting suggested mitigation to infra: disable GC during ramp or shift maintenance. pinging @infra-team

sre-bot: Automated check: Found overlapping maintenance (KV-cache GC) — preflight result=FAIL. Reason: unstable kernel IO during GC may spike p95.

Maya: Manual decision: hold rollout. Creating incident RT-5109 and marking change-window blocked.

ops-bot: incident RT-5109 created by Maya — title: "Preflight: KV-cache GC overlaps r2030 ramp". Assignees: @infra-team.

Priya: Temp workaround if infra can't move GC: change canary to warm-warm traffic (use prefix cache warmup) and reduce initial ramp to 1% for 15m. But prefer moving GC.

Nikhil: Good call. Let's not risk a mid-ramp GC. Blocking request posted to infra slack channel with suggested times.

infra-me (from infra slack): We can shift GC from 10:07 -> 03:00 UTC. Will confirm within 10m.

Maya: Thanks. We'll keep this thread as the coordination point. If infra confirms, we'll re-run preflight and proceed. If not, we reschedule release.

deploy-bot: current preflight status: BLOCKED -> awaiting maintenance change.

Priya: Adding note to release notes draft: "Blocked: KV-cache GC scheduled during change window; release paused pending infra schedule change."

Maya: Quick checklist for follow-up: (1) update runbook with automatic maintenance overlap detection, (2) add infra knob to disable scheduled GC during canaries, (3) add a small preflight synthetic that warms cache before ramp. I'll open PRs.

Nikhil: I'll update release calendar and notify PMs.

infra-me: Confirmed new GC time 03:05 UTC. Adjusted on gpu-pool-9.

sre-bot: Re-running preflight: all checks PASS.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed -> ready to start rollout. Traffic plan: 2% -> 20% over 8m.

Maya: Starting rollout. Keep SLI sampling at 1.0 for first 12m. Triage channel is this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy started roll-2030-11  image=redwood/infer:r2030  region=eu-central  service=embed-service  traffic=2%

Priya: Monitoring: p95 steady, 5xx stable <0.2%. No anomalies after warmup.

Maya: Great. Moving to 10% in 4m. Team, be ready to abort if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

Nikhil: Noted. Will watch traces and k8s events.

Maya: Adding final release note: "Release proceeded after maintenance reschedule; preflight blocked then cleared for r2030. Documented maintenance-overlap detection in runbook."

ops-bot: incident RT-5109 closed (resolution: rescheduled maintenance, added runbook item).
